title: Partners and agreements
description: Accommodation, public bodies, companies and associations the beach has an agreement with, customer categories and partner account.
emptyHint: Add the hotels, B&Bs, public bodies and associations you have an agreement with.
agreementsHint: Agreement conditions (discount, fixed prices, quota, link) are managed in the prices.
agreementsLink: Go to Prices → Codes and agreements

fields.name: Name
fields.activeHelp: An inactive partner stays in the history but is not offered on new bookings.

form.contactsHelp: Optional: used by the beach to contact the partner, never written to the logs.
form.billingHelp: Optional: shown on the statement; the invoice stays outside Arenile.

categories.title: Customer categories
categories.description: Residents, over 65, people with disabilities and their companion, large families: recipients of agreements.
categories.emptyHint: Create the categories promised in the tender offer, such as residents or over 65.
categories.name: Name
categories.codeHelp: Lower case letters, numbers and hyphens (e.g. residents).
categories.registerHelp: Groups the agreements in the register for the municipality.
categories.requirementHelp: E.g. proof of residence: the desk records only the check, never a copy.
categories.formDescription: The category is assigned to customers from their card.
categories.deleteConfirm: Delete the category {{name}}? Not possible while customers or agreements use it.

detail.title: Partner
detail.deleteConfirm: Delete the partner {{name}}? Not possible if it has agreements or bookings.

errors.incomplete: Choose the last day of the period too.
errors.reversed: The end date is before the start date.
errors.tooLong: The period can last at most 400 days.

statement.noBookings: No bookings charged to the partner in the period
statement.forbidden: Viewing the statement requires the permission to read reports.

payments.title: Payments received
payments.recordDescription: Records a payment received from the partner: it lowers the account balance.
payments.referenceHelp: E.g. bank transfer or invoice number.
payments.voidDescription: The payment of {{amount}} stays in the list with the reason, but no longer counts in the balance.

agreementForm.recipientsHelp: Who the agreement applies to and which register category it appears in.
agreementForm.noPartners: No partners: create one in Partners and agreements
agreementForm.noCategories: No categories: create one in Partners and agreements
agreementForm.packPricesHelp: Optional: a fixed daily price replaces the pack price (e.g. residents' daily pass €12). The discount above applies to the other packs.
agreementForm.scopeHelp: Empty = every pack and every season; zones, periods, days and slots are limited in the conditions.
agreementForm.applyToExtrasHelp: Otherwise extras stay at full price, except those chosen above.
agreementForm.quotaHelp: Optional, per day: maximum spots under the agreement and reserved spots, enforced by the database.
agreementForm.quotaReleaseHelp: Unused reserved spots go back on sale; default 3.
agreementForm.requirementHelp: E.g. hotel confirmation or membership card; the desk ticks "verified".
agreementForm.channelsHelp: Online needs a code; the agreement link can be copied below after saving.

booking.sectionHint: Agreement, partner the guest comes from and group.
booking.verifiedHint: {{requirement}}: date and operator are recorded, never a copy of the document.
booking.partnerHint: Accommodation or partner the guest comes from.
booking.shareHint: The share charged to the partner goes on its statement.
booking.groupOriginHint: Optional, when it is not a partner.
booking.guestNamesHint: Optional, one per line: no other guest data.
booking.editDescription: Changing the agreement re-prices the booking: you first see the difference to collect or refund.

customer.title: Agreement and categories
customer.agreementHint: Proposed automatically on every new booking of the customer.
customer.verifyDescription: Date and operator are recorded, never a copy or the number of the document.
customer.noteHint: Optional and short (e.g. card 2027); never document numbers.
customer.editDescription: The default agreement is proposed on every booking; categories identify the customer and suggest their agreements.

validation.vat: Letters and numbers only, at most 16.
validation.amount: Enter an amount greater than zero.
validation.reservedOverMax: Reserved spots cannot exceed the maximum.
validation.packPrice: Choose the pack and the price.
validation.packDuplicate: This pack already has a fixed price.

problems.agreement_quota_exceeded: The agreement quota is used up for these dates.
problems.agreement_not_applicable: The agreement does not apply to this booking.
problems.partner_in_use: The partner has agreements or bookings: deactivate it instead of deleting it.
problems.customer_category_in_use: The category is used by customers or agreements: deactivate it instead of deleting it.
